x-code-samples.content:
import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.procore.com")

payload = "{\"project_id\":12345,\"budget_line_item\":{\"wbs_code_id\":67890,\"original_budget_amount\":\"10000.00\",\"uom\":\"hours\",\"quantity\":250.5,\"unit_cost\":123.5,\"calculation_strategy\":\"manual\"}}"

headers = { 'content-type': "application/json" }

conn.request("POST", "/rest/v1.1/budget_line_items", payload, headers)

res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()

print(data.decode("utf-8"))

x-changelog.summary: Introducing v1.1 Create Budget Line Items endpoint
x-changelog.description:
'wbs_code_id' is replacing the 'cost_code_id' and 'line_item_type_id' parameters for creating Budget Line Items.
Previously, we required 'cost_code_id' and 'line_item_type_id', along with all other attributes in order to create a Budget Line Item.
Now, developers may only send 'wbs_code_id' and succesfully create a Budget Line Item.

As well, 'wbs_code' is now a property of the response of a successful Budget Line Item creation.
The new endpoint will also no longer respond with fields related to Budget columns, e.g. "approved_budget_changes", "projected_costs", "direct_costs", etc...

When migrating from v1.0 to v1.1, cost_code_id and line_item_type_id params must be converted to a Work Breakdown Structure Code, which can be found using the Work Breakdown Structure Codes List endpoint (https://developers.procore.com/reference/rest/v1/codes#list-project-wbs-codes).
Once the Work Breakdown Structure containing the same Cost Code and Line Item Type is found, the ID can be used as the 'wbs_code_id' parameter for the Budget Line Item Create request.

x-changelog.summary: Added new currency_configuration property to the budget_line_item object after creation
x-changelog.description: The budget line item object now contains the currency_configuration object.
